meta.validation: Zone anchors, bank identifiers, enabled capability defaults and nine layer identifiers were checked against the listed source files.
uncertainties: Model availability and results depend on saved Settings, installed assets and current index state.
This artifact does not specify a universal audio chunk duration; limits depend on the configured runtime and request path.

identity.name: AM Tri-Modal Stage
identity.purpose: Coordinate session audio, text/audio/spectrogram retrieval, parameter banks, timeline review and project output.

responsibilities: Attach a session audio file and inspect its waveform and spectrogram.
Navigate the playhead, time range and analysis nodes; pin the Work Axis panel.
Save, open or start a session snapshot.
Submit Semantic Search Brief using the selected Qwen or EmbeddingGemma 2 text index; configure retrieval instructions.
Run CLAP audio and SigLIP2 spectrogram analysis over analysis nodes.
Run enabled audio/text specialist paths, including Gemma audio identity/value passes and available LFM3, librosa, Indic or voice features.
Automation queues selected analysis steps and reports step outcomes.

conditional_capabilities.spec.gemma.*: Disabled by default in capability registry.
conditional_capabilities.side-meta.helm: Disabled by default in capability registry.

responsibilities: Select a mask from the nine acoustic domain layers.
Client Stage-2 smooths retrieved results already present in the session; it does not run another search.
Server Stage-2 runs a separate second vector retrieval using selected text-index seeds.
Cross-Modal Interpolation Bridge previews interpolation between available states.
Review parameter timelines by modality or layer.
Review modality result banks and separate Qwen/EmbeddingGemma 2 text banks.
Run value-pass actions where enabled and inputs are available.
Use Clean Macro, automation outputs, priority timeline and text-feature exports.
Save the session state as a project snapshot.

text.separation_rule: Qwen and EmbeddingGemma 2 results are held in different parameter banks.

awtd.role: Identity/role result bank; catalogue defaults remain available before a value pass.
awtd.provenance: Operator product terminology; code verifies separate bank ids, not a per-field interpretation of each acronym term.

value_semantics.resolved: A separate value-pass result bank; output may use retrieval/anchor values or catalogue fallback.

automation.sequence_behavior: Selected steps run in order. Successful results are recorded per step; failure and cancellation are surfaced by the run path.

invariants: Stage consumes indexes; it does not expose index rebuild controls.
Index rebuilds are explicit Service Bay operations.
Qwen and EmbeddingGemma 2 text banks are not merged.
Client Stage-2 smoothing and server Stage-2 retrieval are different operations.
Opening Stage does not by itself request an embedding or index build.
